notes: No SM section describes this case. Every row comes from SM 2.2 rules 4, 6, 7 and 9, 2.3, 2.4 and 5.2 as docs/errata/2026-11-22-relayed-prompts.md applies them. Every credited second is level C with via_relay, and witnessed.

A mouse jiggler gives input in every slot, so every slot is present by input_any; the PC has no key counter and idle_keys_s is null. T3 Code's window, which hosts the session and resolves to tide-tables, is in front throughout. No presence or focus code applies, so an uncredited second is X.agent_only while a turn runs and X.no_anchor otherwise. T1 fills 105 s, under the 120 s cap, so none is X.bucket_cap.

Rules 6 and 7, tested at each stamp, would hold: the jiggler's input 3.1 s before it, T3's window hosting the session in front at it, and a plausible length. Both records say client mobile, T3's phone app, so both prompts skip rules 6 and 7 and are relayed (SM 2.2). relayed_prompts counts them; typed_prompts counts the human_typed prompts, of which there are none.

With client web in both records, both prompts would be human_typed at level B, and the case would credit 487 s, P 332, SUP 125 and READ 30, where it credits 197 s at level C. README.md works it out minute by minute.
